slides.headline: What does unsecured mean?
slides.body: Unsecured business loans are approved based on business revenue and trading history rather than property or asset security. Lenders assess cash flow, bank statements and overall performance to determine borrowing capacity. A personal guarantee from a director is still typically required, even without property involved.

caption:
Not every business owns property, and not every business wants to put it up as security even when they do.

Unsecured business loans are assessed on how the business performs, revenue, trading history and bank statement conduct, rather than what it owns. A personal guarantee from a director is still typically part of the structure, even without property involved.

Wondering if your business would be assessed on performance alone? Reach out.

General information only. This does not constitute financial, legal, accounting or tax advice. Credit is subject to lender assessment, eligibility and approval criteria. Fees, charges, terms and conditions may apply.
